english.title: Fail to deliver up lost property found on the Midland Metro to an authorised officer / the operator
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having found an item of lost property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM..), on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System, failed, as soon as practicable to, deliver it up to an authorised officer or the operator
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 12 and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
